rows.text:
A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Ichor Memosprite: Winged Serpent, a distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It is in the rudimentary form of a flying snake, enough to intimidate its assailants.
Its twisted rationality went completely mad in the black tide, and that intense self-defense impulse imperceptibly took on a fantastical hue.
